scripts.helper: TRIPLE=$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's|host: ||p') && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && touch "src-tauri/binaries/burrow-helper-$TRIPLE" && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin burrow-helper && cp "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-src-tauri/target}/release/burrow-helper" "src-tauri/binaries/burrow-helper-$TRIPLE"
scripts.app: npm run helper && tauri build --bundles app
